Hi Sam —

Thanks again for taking the time today — really helpful conversation on your token-cost concerns and the latency targets for your customer-facing features. Quick recap:

- Primary goals: reduce inference cost per request, keep 95th pct latency under 350ms, and enable canary rollouts for model updates.
- Key stakeholders: Priya (infra), Mike (ML/ops), and your platform team.
- Next best step: 30-minute product demo + short technical deep-dive so we can align on architecture and potential integration approaches.

Could you please pick one of these options? I'll send a calendar invite once you confirm and loop in our Solutions Engineer (Aditya) and Vanessa (AE):

Option A: Tue, Feb 17 — 10:00-10:30 AM PT
Option B: Wed, Feb 18 — 2:00-2:30 PM PT
Option C: Thu, Feb 19 — 11:00-11:30 AM PT

If none of those work, feel free to propose two windows that fit Priya and Mike. Attached is a 1-page demo agenda so you know what we'll cover.

Agenda (attached): 1) Quick product overview (5m) 2) Live demo tailored to your use-case (15m) 3) Integration patterns + next steps (10m)

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the summary, and appreciate the clear agenda. Priya (infra) and Mike (ML/ops) want to join and would like some time in the session to dig into the KV cache and batching behavior — sounds like that will be important for our throughput targets.

The times you proposed look doable except Wed 2pm conflicts with our sprint planning. Two candidates that work for us:

- Tue, Feb 17 — 11:00-11:30 AM PT

If you can do Tue at 11a that'd be great (we need the earlier slot so Priya can attend before a later leadership sync). Please confirm who from Redwood will join and whether you can include a brief notes doc after the session summarizing recommended model/quantization profiles.

Thanks,
